_about: What a deck is trying to do, read from its cards. Each theme scores every non-land card: the weights of its patterns that match the rules text (lower-cased), plus a weight for the card's main role and one for its card type, capped at 1 per card. A theme's score is the share of the deck's non-land cards that lean on it, in percent. These weights are reasoned guesses, not fitted to labelled decks. Edit, then restart.
